name: scan-planner-reproduction
title: Integrate SCAN-Planner Foxy with Lite3 Physics Simulation
description: Port the pinned SCAN ROS 2 planner core to Foxy and validate a versioned TCP closed loop against a pinned Lite3 Isaac policy simulation on the 5070 Ti.
creator: sun
notes: V3 uses the pinned sensor-rig URDF with V12 model_149999 plus live MID-360-like and D435i-like simulated sensors. V4--V6 remain immutable human-change-requested evidence. V7 candidate03 remains immutable with human review pending. The procedural V8 candidate passed automated gates but Dr Sun rejected its hand-authored human representation on 2026-08-14; it is immutable negative evidence and will not be submitted. V8 R2 now references NVIDIA's versioned Isaac Sim 5.1 male_adult_police_04 asset. The official Biped AnimationGraph runs in a separate bounded process and produces a deterministic 101-joint retarget cache; the Direct-GPU Lite3 process replays the cache without the People graph. A separate hidden 1.70 m x 0.30 m capsule owns collision, clearance, and both sensor targets. Visual preflight06 passed its automated composition gate and produced a directly viewable local MP4. V8 R2 remains in progress pending Dr Sun's appearance review before SCAN no-contact/full runs. No training or real-robot work is authorized.
